Additional services are used in programme-guide, live-TV, movie and series information cards. The app continues to work normally when they are disabled or do not find a match.
TMDB API key or Read Access Token

When enabled, the programme title, year and type are sent to the selected metadata service. The TMDB API key or Read Access Token is encrypted with Android Keystore. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. TVmaze data: CC BY-SA.
Game data for your selected team sports is fetched directly from API-Sports.

The key is encrypted with Android Keystore and sent to API-Sports only in an HTTPS header. The app tracks provider quota headers and can use cached data up to 24 hours old during an outage. Logos and trademarks belong to their respective rights holders; public or commercial use may require separate permission.
Save an API-Sports key to open sport and competition selection.
The competition list could not be loaded. Check the API key and connection.
Match the display to the picture
Automatically starts the next available episode when the current episode ends.

Switches the television to a refresh rate the stream divides into evenly, which removes the judder on camera pans. Most televisions go black for about a second when the rate changes, and nothing is switched unless it divides evenly.
Media3 default preserves the current behavior. Low latency suits responsive live streams; Stability increases buffering for unreliable connections. The choice applies to the next playback.
Hardware decoding is preferred. Sohva TV automatically tries the next compatible decoder if the preferred decoder cannot start.
Standard retries 3 times after 2, 4, and 6 seconds. Persistent retries up to 8 times and increases the delay to a maximum of 30 seconds. Manual Reconnect always remains available.
Changes the language of Sohva TV itself. Restarts the app to apply.
Draws everything on screen smaller, for a very large screen or a projector.
How much room posters, logos and backdrops may take. A new limit applies the next time Sohva TV starts.
Movies and series try the primary language first, then the secondary language. Automatic keeps the provider default.

The backup contains IPTV addresses and credentials, custom channel settings, lists and parental controls. Everything is protected with your password before it is written to the file.
The password is not stored and cannot be recovered. The programme guide cache is not included.
This limits channel and movie/series refreshes for this source. M3U series are recognized from S01E01 or 1x01 naming.
Applies only to this source. After saving, the correction appears immediately in current and future guide data.
Updates run in the background when a network connection is available.

HTTP is allowed for IPTV compatibility. With HTTP, credentials and streams are visible on the local network, so use only a trusted network or HTTPS. Sohva Sport always connects to API-Sports over HTTPS.
